claim: AWS Cloud WAN is a new way to connect networks that previously could be done with Transit Gateways, VPC peering and IPsec VPN tunnels; where network and security posture constructs used to be defined in one place and the networks in another, Cloud WAN centralizes all of these constructs in a single place.

evidence.quote: AWS Cloud WAN is a new way to connect networks together that we were previously able to do with Transit Gateways, VPC Peering, and IPSEC VPN tunnels.
You would have your network and security posture constructs defined in one place, and your networks in another. Cloud WAN allows you to centralize all of these constructs in a single place.
